content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing the same issue and would like to know which solution you applied that made it work.

Hello, I couldn't identify the root cause, but my workaround was to remove the controller from the engineering project and set it up again from scratch. If you can provide more details about your configuration, I might be able to assist further. Best regards [user_name]

Hi, My issue is that the [product_name] device is not receiving any data from the controller. I followed your approach as mentioned above but could not achieve communication. The only difference in my project is that I am not using an operator panel, and these are the IP addresses: Controller: 192.168.0.1 [product_name]: 192.168.0.10 PC: 192.168.0.6 The software settings are identical. Thank you for your assistance. [user_name]

Would it be possible for you to share a photo of your setup as I did? That might help me identify what could be wrong. Are you communicating bits or analog signals between the controller and the [product_name] device?

Solutions attempted include reconfiguring and resetting the project, but the core problem persists.
